Burntato uses custom errors and explicit events across the Diamond, hook, and Operator router. Decode by contract ABI and selector; do not infer failure only from a provider string.

## Game and settlement events

- `RoundStarted`
- `PotatoPurchased`
- `EmissionFinalized`
- `WinnerReserveFunded`
- `NextRoundWinnerFunded`
- `WinnerReserveApplied`
- `RoundSettled`
- `WinnerClaimed`

## Recovery and Treasury events

- `RecoveryCommitted`
- `StalledRecoveryWithdrawn`
- `RecoveryReserveFunded`
- `RecoveryReserveApplied`
- `RecoveryClaimed`
- `TreasuryEthClaimed`
- `TreasuryPotatoClaimed`
- `TreasuryRewardsAllocated`, `TreasuryRewardsCanceled`
- `TreasuryRewardRoundActivated`, `TreasuryRewardFinalized`, `TreasuryRewardReleased`

## Market and buyback events

- `MarketConfigured`, `MarketCurvePinned`, `MarketLaunched`
- `BuybackFunded`, `BuybackReserveFunded`, `BuybackExecuted`
- hook `Trade`, `HookFee`, and `HookFeeAllocated`

## Operator events

- `RevenueQueued`, `ForcedRevenueRecognized`, `RevenueAccrued`
- `OperatorRegistered`, `OperatorWeightUpdated`, `OperatorInvalidated`
- `OperatorRewardClaimed`, `TreasuryRewardClaimed`

## Errors worth translating

| Error | User-facing interpretation |
| --- | --- |
| `IncorrectPayment(expected, received)` | The Grab price changed. Refresh and try again. |
| `RoundExpired` | This round ended before the transaction landed. |
| `RoundNotExpired` | The countdown is still active. |
| `PurchasesNotInitialized` | Gameplay has not been opened on this deployment. |
| `ProtocolPaused` | This action is disabled by the emergency pause. |
| `TransferRestricted(from, to)` | POTATO cannot move through that route. |
| `ExternalBuysDisabled` | User buys are not currently enabled. |
| `BuybackTooSoon(nextBlock)` | Wait until the displayed block. |
| `BuybackUnavailable` | Market or reserve state cannot support a buyback. |
| `VestingIncomplete` | The current emission opportunity is not fully vested. |
| `NothingToClaim` | No eligible balance is currently claimable. |
| `RecoveryWithdrawalTooSoon(availableAt)` | The holderless escape deadline has not arrived. |

Simulation errors should be shown before the wallet prompt when possible. A mined receipt with failure status is still a failed action even if the wallet returned a transaction hash.
